title: AI agent: runs, latency, tokens, cost

list.name: run
list.label: Orchestrator run
list.query: SELECT id AS __value, '#' || id || ' · ' || to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata', 'DD Mon HH24:MI') || ' · ' || CASE WHEN scope_decision IN ('no_issue', 'out_of_scope') THEN 'gate → template' WHEN scope_decision IS NULL THEN 'main agent' ELSE 'gate → main agent' END || ' → ' || coalesce(reply_kind, 'none') || CASE WHEN escalate THEN ' (escalated)' ELSE '' END || ' · "' || coalesce(left(customer_message, 45), 'no customer message') || '"' AS __text FROM agent_runs ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Orchestrator run: one email, step by step (pick a run at the top)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT '#' || r.id AS run, to_char(r.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata', 'DD Mon HH24:MI:SS') AS "time (IST)",
       coalesce(r.customer_message, '(no customer message: summary only)') AS "customer wrote",
       coalesce(r.scope_decision, '-') AS gate,
       CASE WHEN r.scope_decision IN ('no_issue', 'out_of_scope') THEN 'template'
            WHEN r.scope_decision IS NULL THEN 'main agent (no gate)' ELSE 'main agent' END AS "handled by",
       r.reply_kind AS reply, CASE WHEN r.escalate THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS escalated,
       CASE WHEN rv.status = 'REVIEWED' AND rv.agent_was_wrong THEN 'WRONG' WHEN rv.status = 'REVIEWED' THEN 'RIGHT'
            WHEN rv.status = 'SKIPPED' THEN 'not sent' ELSE 'not reviewed yet' END AS review
FROM agent_runs r LEFT JOIN reply_reviews rv ON rv.agent_run_id = r.id WHERE r.id::text = '${run}'

panels.title: Total latency
panels.description: Scope gate + main agent (or template).

targets.rawSql:
WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM agent_runs WHERE id::text = '${run}'),
c AS (SELECT c.*, (greatest(c.input_tokens - c.cached_tokens, 0) * coalesce(p.input_per_1m, 0) + c.cached_tokens * coalesce(p.cached_input_per_1m, 0) + c.output_tokens * coalesce(p.output_per_1m, 0)) / 1e6 AS usd FROM llm_calls c LEFT JOIN model_prices p ON p.model = c.model
      WHERE c.agent_run_id::text = '${run}'),
s AS (SELECT
  coalesce(sum(seconds) FILTER (WHERE purpose = 'scope'), 0) AS gate_s,
  coalesce(sum(seconds) FILTER (WHERE purpose = 'embedding'), 0) AS embed_s,
  coalesce(sum(seconds) FILTER (WHERE purpose = 'rerank'), 0) AS rerank_s,
  coalesce(sum(seconds) FILTER (WHERE purpose = 'agent'), 0) AS llm_s,
  coalesce(sum(usd) FILTER (WHERE purpose = 'scope'), 0) AS gate_usd,
  coalesce(sum(usd) FILTER (WHERE purpose IN ('embedding', 'rerank')), 0) AS retrieval_usd,
  coalesce(sum(usd) FILTER (WHERE purpose = 'agent'), 0) AS llm_usd,
  coalesce(sum(usd), 0) AS total_usd,
  coalesce(sum(input_tokens), 0) AS input_tokens, coalesce(sum(cached_tokens), 0) AS cached_tokens,
  coalesce(sum(output_tokens), 0) AS output_tokens
  FROM c),
x AS (SELECT s.*, r.seconds AS agent_s, r.retrieval_seconds AS retrieval_s,
             greatest(r.retrieval_seconds - s.embed_s - s.rerank_s, 0) AS search_s,
             greatest(r.loop_seconds - s.llm_s, 0) AS tools_s, s.gate_s + r.seconds AS total_s
      FROM s, r) SELECT total_s AS value FROM x

             greatest(r.retrieval_seconds - s.embed_s - s.rerank_s, 0) AS search_s,
             greatest(r.loop_seconds - s.llm_s, 0) AS tools_s, s.gate_s + r.seconds AS total_s
      FROM s, r) SELECT output_tokens AS value FROM x

panels.title: Waterfall: every step of the run, on one time axis
panels.description: Each bar starts when the step started and is as long as it took. Gaps between LLM turns are tool calls (named) and our own code.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT seq, purpose, model, seconds,
         extract(epoch FROM started_at - min(started_at) OVER ())::numeric AS off,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY purpose ORDER BY seq) AS k
  FROM llm_calls WHERE agent_run_id::text = '${run}'),
g AS (SELECT c.*, lead(off) OVER (ORDER BY seq) AS next_off, lead(purpose) OVER (ORDER BY seq) AS next_purpose FROM c),
tools AS (SELECT (t->>'turn')::int AS turn, string_agg(t->>'name', ', ') AS names, count(*) AS n
          FROM agent_runs r, json_array_elements(r.tool_calls) AS t WHERE r.id::text = '${run}' GROUP BY 1),
steps AS (
  SELECT seq * 2 AS ord, off, seconds::numeric AS dur,
         CASE purpose WHEN 'scope' THEN 'gate' WHEN 'agent' THEN 'llm' ELSE 'retrieval' END AS stage,
         CASE purpose WHEN 'scope' THEN 'Scope gate (' || model || ')'
                      WHEN 'embedding' THEN 'Retrieval: embed the email'
                      WHEN 'rerank' THEN 'Retrieval: rerank SOPs (' || model || ')'
                      WHEN 'agent' THEN 'Main agent: LLM turn ' || k ELSE purpose END AS step
  FROM g
  UNION ALL
  SELECT g.seq * 2 + 1, g.off + g.seconds::numeric, g.next_off - (g.off + g.seconds::numeric),
         CASE WHEN g.purpose = 'agent' THEN 'tools' ELSE 'retrieval' END,
         CASE WHEN g.purpose = 'agent' THEN 'Tools: ' || coalesce(t.names, 'our code')
              WHEN g.purpose = 'embedding' THEN 'Retrieval: BM25 + dense search' ELSE 'our code' END
  FROM g LEFT JOIN tools t ON t.turn = g.k AND g.purpose = 'agent'
  WHERE g.next_off IS NOT NULL AND (g.purpose = 'agent' OR g.next_off - (g.off + g.seconds::numeric) > 0.05))
SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ord) || '. ' || step AS step, round(off, 2) AS "starts at",
       round(CASE WHEN stage = 'gate' THEN dur END, 2) AS "scope gate",
       round(CASE WHEN stage = 'retrieval' THEN dur END, 2) AS retrieval,
       round(CASE WHEN stage = 'llm' THEN dur END, 2) AS "main agent LLM",
       round(CASE WHEN stage = 'tools' THEN dur END, 2) AS tools
FROM steps ORDER BY ord

WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM agent_runs WHERE id::text = '${run}'),
c AS (SELECT c.*, (greatest(c.input_tokens - c.cached_tokens, 0) * coalesce(p.input_per_1m, 0) + c.cached_tokens * coalesce(p.cached_input_per_1m, 0) + c.output_tokens * coalesce(p.output_per_1m, 0)) / 1e6 AS usd FROM llm_calls c LEFT JOIN model_prices p ON p.model = c.model
      WHERE c.agent_run_id::text = '${run}'),
s AS (SELECT
  coalesce(sum(seconds) FILTER (WHERE purpose = 'scope'), 0) AS gate_s,
  coalesce(sum(seconds) FILTER (WHERE purpose = 'embedding'), 0) AS embed_s,
  coalesce(sum(seconds) FILTER (WHERE purpose = 'rerank'), 0) AS rerank_s,
  coalesce(sum(seconds) FILTER (WHERE purpose = 'agent'), 0) AS llm_s,
  coalesce(sum(usd) FILTER (WHERE purpose = 'scope'), 0) AS gate_usd,
  coalesce(sum(usd) FILTER (WHERE purpose IN ('embedding', 'rerank')), 0) AS retrieval_usd,
  coalesce(sum(usd) FILTER (WHERE purpose = 'agent'), 0) AS llm_usd,
  coalesce(sum(usd), 0) AS total_usd,
  coalesce(sum(input_tokens), 0) AS input_tokens, coalesce(sum(cached_tokens), 0) AS cached_tokens,
  coalesce(sum(output_tokens), 0) AS output_tokens
  FROM c),
x AS (SELECT s.*, r.seconds AS agent_s, r.retrieval_seconds AS retrieval_s,
             greatest(r.retrieval_seconds - s.embed_s - s.rerank_s, 0) AS search_s,
             greatest(r.loop_seconds - s.llm_s, 0) AS tools_s, s.gate_s + r.seconds AS total_s
      FROM s, r)
SELECT gate_s AS "scope gate", embed_s AS "retrieval: embed", search_s AS "retrieval: search",
       rerank_s AS "retrieval: rerank", llm_s AS "main agent LLM", tools_s AS tools FROM x

panels.title: Every LLM call: tokens, latency, cost
panels.description: Cached input tokens are part of input and are billed at about 10% of the price.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT c.seq AS "#", CASE c.purpose WHEN 'scope' THEN 'scope gate' WHEN 'agent' THEN 'main agent LLM'
                                    ELSE 'retrieval: ' || c.purpose END AS stage, c.model,
       round(extract(epoch FROM c.started_at - min(c.started_at) OVER ())::numeric, 2) AS "starts at (s)",
       round(c.seconds::numeric, 2) AS "seconds", c.input_tokens AS input, c.cached_tokens AS cached,
       c.input_tokens - c.cached_tokens AS uncached, c.output_tokens AS output,
       round(((greatest(c.input_tokens - c.cached_tokens, 0) * coalesce(p.input_per_1m, 0) + c.cached_tokens * coalesce(p.cached_input_per_1m, 0) + c.output_tokens * coalesce(p.output_per_1m, 0)) / 1e6)::numeric, 6) AS "cost $"
FROM llm_calls c LEFT JOIN model_prices p ON p.model = c.model WHERE c.agent_run_id::text = '${run}' ORDER BY c.seq

WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM agent_runs WHERE id::text = '${run}'),
c AS (SELECT c.*, (greatest(c.input_tokens - c.cached_tokens, 0) * coalesce(p.input_per_1m, 0) + c.cached_tokens * coalesce(p.cached_input_per_1m, 0) + c.output_tokens * coalesce(p.output_per_1m, 0)) / 1e6 AS usd FROM llm_calls c LEFT JOIN model_prices p ON p.model = c.model
      WHERE c.agent_run_id::text = '${run}'),
s AS (SELECT
  coalesce(sum(seconds) FILTER (WHERE purpose = 'scope'), 0) AS gate_s,
  coalesce(sum(seconds) FILTER (WHERE purpose = 'embedding'), 0) AS embed_s,
  coalesce(sum(seconds) FILTER (WHERE purpose = 'rerank'), 0) AS rerank_s,
  coalesce(sum(seconds) FILTER (WHERE purpose = 'agent'), 0) AS llm_s,
  coalesce(sum(usd) FILTER (WHERE purpose = 'scope'), 0) AS gate_usd,
  coalesce(sum(usd) FILTER (WHERE purpose IN ('embedding', 'rerank')), 0) AS retrieval_usd,
  coalesce(sum(usd) FILTER (WHERE purpose = 'agent'), 0) AS llm_usd,
  coalesce(sum(usd), 0) AS total_usd,
  coalesce(sum(input_tokens), 0) AS input_tokens, coalesce(sum(cached_tokens), 0) AS cached_tokens,
  coalesce(sum(output_tokens), 0) AS output_tokens
  FROM c),
x AS (SELECT s.*, r.seconds AS agent_s, r.retrieval_seconds AS retrieval_s,
             greatest(r.retrieval_seconds - s.embed_s - s.rerank_s, 0) AS search_s,
             greatest(r.loop_seconds - s.llm_s, 0) AS tools_s, s.gate_s + r.seconds AS total_s
      FROM s, r)
SELECT gate_usd AS "scope gate", retrieval_usd AS retrieval, llm_usd AS "main agent LLM" FROM x

panels.title: Tools the main agent called
panels.description: Only the tools listed on the retrieved SOP sections are offered. 'after turn' is empty for runs saved before it was recorded.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (t.call->>'turn') AS "after turn", t.call->>'name' AS tool,
       CASE WHEN (t.call->>'ok')::boolean THEN 'ok' ELSE 'error' END AS result,
       t.call->'arguments' AS arguments, left((t.call->'output')::text, 140) AS "output (start)"
FROM agent_runs r, json_array_elements(r.tool_calls) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(call, n)
WHERE r.id::text = '${run}' ORDER BY t.n

WITH r AS (SELECT sops_retrieved, sops_followed FROM agent_runs WHERE id::text = '${run}'),
retrieved AS (SELECT s->>'sop_id' AS sop, (s->>'grade')::int AS grade FROM r, json_array_elements(r.sops_retrieved) s)
SELECT sop, grade AS "reranker grade (0-3)",
       CASE WHEN sop IN (SELECT json_array_elements_text(sops_followed) FROM r) THEN 'followed' ELSE 'not used' END AS used
FROM retrieved ORDER BY grade DESC

panels.title: Reply, escalation, gate reason and review

targets.rawSql:
SELECT kv.field, kv.value FROM agent_runs r LEFT JOIN reply_reviews rv ON rv.agent_run_id = r.id
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
  (1, 'gate reason', coalesce(r.scope_reason, '-')),
  (2, 'reply', coalesce(r.reply, '(no reply)')),
  (3, 'escalation note', coalesce(r.escalation_note, '-')),
  (4, 'summary after this run', r.summary),
  (5, 'review', coalesce(rv.status, '-') || coalesce(': ' || rv.notes, '')),
  (6, 'prompt versions', r.prompt_version || ' · ' || r.model)) AS kv(n, field, value)
WHERE r.id::text = '${run}' ORDER BY kv.n

panels.title: Overall: all agent runs so far (Postgres, exact)

options.content: Cost is an **estimate**: tokens × `model_prices` (from `ai_analyzer/model_prices.json`, OpenAI Standard-tier prices checked 2026-10-14; the `price_source` column shows where each price came from). When prices change, edit the JSON and restart C1 (or run `python -m ai_analyzer prices`): every cost on this page is recomputed. SOP-indexing embeddings at C1 start are not part of any run, so they are not counted here.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS runs FROM agent_runs
SELECT count(*) AS calls FROM llm_calls
SELECT sum(input_tokens + output_tokens) AS tokens FROM llm_calls
SELECT 100.0 * sum(cached_tokens) / nullif(sum(input_tokens), 0) AS cached FROM llm_calls

SELECT sum((greatest(c.input_tokens - c.cached_tokens, 0) * coalesce(p.input_per_1m, 0) + c.cached_tokens * coalesce(p.cached_input_per_1m, 0) + c.output_tokens * coalesce(p.output_per_1m, 0)) / 1e6) AS cost FROM llm_calls c LEFT JOIN model_prices p ON p.model = c.model

SELECT sum((greatest(c.input_tokens - c.cached_tokens, 0) * coalesce(p.input_per_1m, 0) + c.cached_tokens * coalesce(p.cached_input_per_1m, 0) + c.output_tokens * coalesce(p.output_per_1m, 0)) / 1e6) / nullif(count(DISTINCT c.agent_run_id), 0) AS cost FROM llm_calls c LEFT JOIN model_prices p ON p.model = c.model
SELECT avg(seconds) AS seconds FROM agent_runs WHERE (scope_decision IS NULL OR scope_decision IN ('in_scope', 'mixed'))
SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE agent_was_wrong) / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'REVIEWED'), 0) AS wrong FROM reply_reviews

panels.title: Latency percentiles (main agent, orchestrator, each LLM purpose)
panels.description: Exact percentiles over every stored run and LLM call.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'main agent run' AS stage, count(*) AS n,
       round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY seconds)::numeric, 2) AS p50_s,
       round(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY seconds)::numeric, 2) AS p95_s,
       round(percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY seconds)::numeric, 2) AS p99_s,
       round(avg(seconds)::numeric, 2) AS avg_s, round(max(seconds)::numeric, 2) AS max_s
FROM agent_runs WHERE (scope_decision IS NULL OR scope_decision IN ('in_scope', 'mixed'))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'retrieval (per run)', count(*),
       round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY retrieval_seconds)::numeric, 2),
       round(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY retrieval_seconds)::numeric, 2),
       round(percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY retrieval_seconds)::numeric, 2),
       round(avg(retrieval_seconds)::numeric, 2), round(max(retrieval_seconds)::numeric, 2)
FROM agent_runs WHERE (scope_decision IS NULL OR scope_decision IN ('in_scope', 'mixed'))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'agent tool loop (per run)', count(*),
       round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY loop_seconds)::numeric, 2),
       round(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY loop_seconds)::numeric, 2),
       round(percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY loop_seconds)::numeric, 2),
       round(avg(loop_seconds)::numeric, 2), round(max(loop_seconds)::numeric, 2)
FROM agent_runs WHERE (scope_decision IS NULL OR scope_decision IN ('in_scope', 'mixed'))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'orchestrator total (gate + agent or template)', count(*),
       round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t)::numeric, 2),
       round(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t)::numeric, 2),
       round(percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t)::numeric, 2),
       round(avg(t)::numeric, 2), round(max(t)::numeric, 2)
FROM (SELECT r.seconds + coalesce(sum(c.seconds) FILTER (WHERE c.purpose = 'scope'), 0) AS t
      FROM agent_runs r LEFT JOIN llm_calls c ON c.agent_run_id = r.id
      WHERE r.scope_decision IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.id, r.seconds) AS routed
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT 'LLM call: ' || purpose, count(*),
         round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY seconds)::numeric, 2),
         round(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY seconds)::numeric, 2),
         round(percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY seconds)::numeric, 2),
         round(avg(seconds)::numeric, 2), round(max(seconds)::numeric, 2)
  FROM llm_calls GROUP BY purpose ORDER BY purpose
) AS per_purpose

panels.title: Tokens and cost by purpose (all runs)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT c.purpose, c.model, count(*) AS calls,
       sum(c.input_tokens) AS input, sum(c.cached_tokens) AS cached,
       sum(c.input_tokens - c.cached_tokens) AS uncached, sum(c.output_tokens) AS output,
       round(100.0 * sum(c.cached_tokens) / nullif(sum(c.input_tokens), 0), 1) AS cached_pct,
       round(sum((greatest(c.input_tokens - c.cached_tokens, 0) * coalesce(p.input_per_1m, 0) + c.cached_tokens * coalesce(p.cached_input_per_1m, 0) + c.output_tokens * coalesce(p.output_per_1m, 0)) / 1e6)::numeric, 5) AS cost_usd,
       round((100.0 * sum((greatest(c.input_tokens - c.cached_tokens, 0) * coalesce(p.input_per_1m, 0) + c.cached_tokens * coalesce(p.cached_input_per_1m, 0) + c.output_tokens * coalesce(p.output_per_1m, 0)) / 1e6) / nullif(sum(sum((greatest(c.input_tokens - c.cached_tokens, 0) * coalesce(p.input_per_1m, 0) + c.cached_tokens * coalesce(p.cached_input_per_1m, 0) + c.output_tokens * coalesce(p.output_per_1m, 0)) / 1e6)) OVER (), 0))::numeric, 1) AS cost_share_pct,
       max(p.source) AS price_source
FROM llm_calls c LEFT JOIN model_prices p ON p.model = c.model
GROUP BY c.purpose, c.model
ORDER BY cost_usd DESC

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(c.created_at, '1d'), sum((greatest(c.input_tokens - c.cached_tokens, 0) * coalesce(p.input_per_1m, 0) + c.cached_tokens * coalesce(p.cached_input_per_1m, 0) + c.output_tokens * coalesce(p.output_per_1m, 0)) / 1e6) AS "cost (USD)"
FROM llm_calls c LEFT JOIN model_prices p ON p.model = c.model WHERE $__timeFilter(c.created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1d'),
       sum(input_tokens - cached_tokens) AS "uncached input", sum(cached_tokens) AS cached,
       sum(output_tokens) AS output
FROM llm_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

FROM agent_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Was the agent right? (reviews)
panels.description: Filled in by a human reviewer (reply_reviews). Until runs are reviewed they show NOT REVIEWED YET.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN rv.status = 'REVIEWED' AND rv.agent_was_wrong THEN 'WRONG' WHEN rv.status = 'REVIEWED' THEN 'RIGHT' WHEN rv.status = 'SKIPPED' THEN 'SKIPPED (not sent)' ELSE 'NOT REVIEWED YET' END AS verdict, count(*) AS runs
FROM reply_reviews rv GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT outcome, count(*) AS runs, count(*) FILTER (WHERE escalate) AS escalated,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE reply_kind = 'closing') AS closing_replies
FROM agent_runs GROUP BY outcome ORDER BY runs DESC

SELECT t.call->>'name' AS tool, count(*) AS calls,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE (t.call->>'ok')::boolean IS NOT TRUE) AS errors,
       count(DISTINCT r.id) AS runs
FROM agent_runs r, json_array_elements(r.tool_calls) AS t(call)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY calls DESC

panels.title: Orchestrator: scope gate, then main agent or template

options.content: Every customer message goes through the **orchestrator** (`agent/orchestrator.py`): the **scope gate** (`llm_calls.purpose = scope`, a small model) decides, then **in_scope / mixed** go to the **main agent** (purposes agent, rerank, embedding) and **no_issue / out_of_scope** get a template (no agent run, no main-agent cost). Runs with no gate decision are older runs or messages with no verified customer (summary only).

SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY seconds) FROM llm_calls WHERE purpose = 'scope'

panels.title: Gate cost per message
panels.description: Approx: tokens x model_prices.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum((greatest(c.input_tokens - c.cached_tokens, 0) * coalesce(p.input_per_1m, 0) + c.cached_tokens * coalesce(p.cached_input_per_1m, 0) + c.output_tokens * coalesce(p.output_per_1m, 0)) / 1e6) / nullif(count(DISTINCT c.agent_run_id), 0) FROM llm_calls c LEFT JOIN model_prices p ON p.model = c.model WHERE c.purpose = 'scope'

panels.title: Approx net saved by the gate
panels.description: Agent runs avoided (template runs x the average main-agent run cost) minus what the gate cost on every message. Negative means the gate costs more than it saves so far.

targets.rawSql:
WITH run_cost AS (
  SELECT c.agent_run_id, sum((greatest(c.input_tokens - c.cached_tokens, 0) * coalesce(p.input_per_1m, 0) + c.cached_tokens * coalesce(p.cached_input_per_1m, 0) + c.output_tokens * coalesce(p.output_per_1m, 0)) / 1e6) FILTER (WHERE c.purpose <> 'scope') AS agent_usd,
         sum((greatest(c.input_tokens - c.cached_tokens, 0) * coalesce(p.input_per_1m, 0) + c.cached_tokens * coalesce(p.cached_input_per_1m, 0) + c.output_tokens * coalesce(p.output_per_1m, 0)) / 1e6) FILTER (WHERE c.purpose = 'scope') AS gate_usd
  FROM llm_calls c LEFT JOIN model_prices p ON p.model = c.model GROUP BY 1),
avg_agent_run AS (
  SELECT avg(rc.agent_usd) AS usd FROM agent_runs r JOIN run_cost rc ON rc.agent_run_id = r.id
  WHERE r.in_reply_to_id IS NOT NULL AND (r.scope_decision IS NULL OR r.scope_decision IN ('in_scope', 'mixed')) AND rc.agent_usd > 0)
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.scope_decision IN ('no_issue', 'out_of_scope')) * (SELECT usd FROM avg_agent_run)
       - coalesce(sum(rc.gate_usd), 0)
FROM agent_runs r LEFT JOIN run_cost rc ON rc.agent_run_id = r.id WHERE r.scope_decision IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Gate failures (fail open)
panels.description: The gate errored, so the message went to the main agent (fail open). Should be 0.

panels.title: Routing per day, by gate decision

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1d'), scope_decision AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM agent_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND scope_decision IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Per route: what happened next
panels.description: avg_total_s = gate + main agent (0 for templates).

targets.rawSql:
WITH calls AS (
  SELECT c.agent_run_id, sum(c.seconds) FILTER (WHERE c.purpose = 'scope') AS gate_s, sum((greatest(c.input_tokens - c.cached_tokens, 0) * coalesce(p.input_per_1m, 0) + c.cached_tokens * coalesce(p.cached_input_per_1m, 0) + c.output_tokens * coalesce(p.output_per_1m, 0)) / 1e6) AS usd
  FROM llm_calls c LEFT JOIN model_prices p ON p.model = c.model GROUP BY 1)
SELECT r.scope_decision AS gate_decision,
       CASE WHEN r.scope_decision IN ('in_scope', 'mixed') THEN 'main agent' ELSE 'template' END AS route,
       count(*) AS runs, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.reply IS NOT NULL) AS replied,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.reply IS NULL) AS silent, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.escalate) AS escalated,
       round(avg(coalesce(calls.gate_s, 0) + r.seconds)::numeric, 2) AS avg_total_s,
       round(avg(calls.usd)::numeric, 5) AS avg_cost_usd
FROM agent_runs r LEFT JOIN calls ON calls.agent_run_id = r.id
WHERE r.scope_decision IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY runs DESC

panels.description: Read the reasons to spot a gate that is too strict.

SELECT id AS run, to_char(created_at, 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "time", scope_decision AS decision, reply_kind,
       scope_reason AS reason
FROM agent_runs WHERE scope_decision IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Live from C1 since its last start (Prometheus): bucket-estimated percentiles, rates
LLM call latency p95 by purpose (5m window)
